title: Jin - I Gotta Love (Remix)
description: While Kanye was only on the chorus for the original "I Gotta Love", this version has a verse from him, with lyrics that would later be reused for "I Wonder" from Graduation. Meant to be a released as a remix, according to Jin, but that never happened and instead leaked online sometime in 2005, likely from the bootleg Jin mixtape The G.a.R.T.E.E.'s World. Existence of this leak was only known through an uncited claim on the Wikipedia page for Jin's album The Rest Is History, before @idrabmolcaf from the Ye Tracker Discord would come forward saying he had found the file on an old laptop of his.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: Released on November 23, 2016, in a three-pack alongside the ‘Green’ and ‘Red’ colorways, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Copper’ combines a black Primeknit upper with a Copper stripe, SPLY 350 branding, and a translucent black midsole housing full-length Boost.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Sesame’ features a refined color palette that complements the shoe’s minimalist build. The breathable Primeknit upper keeps the heel tab and distinct center stitch detailing but loses the mirrored ‘SPLY-350’ branding. Underneath, a semi-translucent rubber midsole houses a full-length Boost cushioning, while a gum rubber outsole delivers enhanced traction.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Static Reflective' features the same look as the 'Static' colorway, but features reflective accents in the Primeknit yarns. The other details are the same as the 'Static', including a translucent side stripe and 3M reflective detailing on the shoe’s rope laces, Primeknit upper and Three-Stripes branding on the interior heel. The midsole makes use of ridged TPU sidewalls with semi-translucent properties, revealing full-length adidas Boost cushioning within. The 350 V2 'Static Reflective' is exclusive to Yeezy Supply.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 CMPCT
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT ‘Slate Bone’ showcases an understated greyscale finish throughout the upper, crafted from engineered 3D knit textile designed to wrap the foot in a second-skin fit. The sock-like build is equipped with no-tie elastic laces for easy on and off. Responsive cushioning arrives via adidas’ energy-returning Boost midsole, wrapped in semi-translucent TPU cage and exposed through cut-away detailing on the rubber outsole.
